description: Get the latest EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report for Lower 48 working gas: the week's level and change, the year-ago level, the five-year average and the surplus or deficit against it, in Bcf. Set historical=true to add the last N weekly reports. Use when the user asks about US natural gas storage, injections or withdrawals. opa_get_storage covers crude oil at Cushing and the SPR, not gas. This dataset is plan-gated: the API answers HTTP 403 when the account's plan does not include it. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

historical.description: When true, include the last `weeks` weekly reports (default: false).

weeks.description: Number of weekly reports when historical is true, 1 to 52 (default: 4).

name: opa_get_natural_gas_storage
title: Get Natural Gas Storage
